issuing_authority.value: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
issuing_authority.quote: The department shall license or register any applicant who the board certifies is qualified for licensure or registration and who has paid the initial licensure or registration fee.

name.value: Board of Architecture and Interior Design
name.quote: The Board of Architecture and Interior Design is created within the Department of Business and Professional Regulation.

type.quote: The Board of Architecture and Interior Design is created within the Department of Business and Professional Regulation. The board shall consist of 11 members. Five members must be registered architects who have been engaged in the practice of architecture for at least 5 years; three members must be registered interior designers

required.quote: An applicant for licensure as a registered architect shall complete, before licensure, an internship of diversified architectural experience approved by the board, which meets the requirements set forth by rule.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses and certificates of registration.

required.quote: A license or certificate of registration renewal may not be issued to an architect or a registered interior designer by the department until the licensee or registrant submits proof satisfactory to the department that, during the 2 years before application for renewal, the licensee or registrant participated per biennium in not less than 20 hours of at least 50 minutes each per biennium of continuing education approved by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: participated per biennium in not less than 20 hours of at least 50 minutes each per biennium of continuing education approved by the board.

period_years.quote: during the 2 years before application for renewal

value: 2 hours in specialized or advanced courses on any portion of the Florida Building Code
topical_requirements.quote: the board shall require, by rule adopted pursuant to ss. 120.536(1) and 120.54, 2 hours in specialized or advanced courses on any portion of the Florida Building Code, adopted pursuant to part IV of chapter 553, relating to the licensee's respective area of practice.

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for a license by endorsement as an architect or registration as a registered interior designer an applicant who: ... (c) Has passed the prescribed licensure examination and holds a valid certificate issued by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards, and holds a valid license to practice architecture issued by another state or jurisdiction of the United States.

requirements.value: Applicant must qualify to take the prescribed examination and have passed a substantially equivalent examination in another jurisdiction and satisfied the internship requirements (481.211); OR hold a valid license with substantially equivalent criteria; OR have passed the prescribed exam and hold a valid NCARB certificate plus a valid license from another state. Out-of-state applicants must also complete a 2-hour wind mitigation course approved by the board.
requirements.quote: An architect who is licensed in another state who seeks qualification for license by endorsement under this subsection must complete a 2-hour class approved by the board on wind mitigation techniques.

title_protection.quote: Use the name or title "architect," "registered architect," or "registered interior designer" when the person is not then the holder of a valid license or certificate of registration issued pursuant to this part.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not knowingly: (a) Practice architecture unless the person is an architect or a registered architect

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of s. 455.227(1), s. 481.221, or s. 481.223, or any rule of the board or department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of s. 455.227(1), s. 481.221, or s. 481.223, or any rule of the board or department lawfully adopted pursuant to this part or chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or procure a license to practice architecture by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain or procure a license to practice architecture by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice architecture revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by another jurisdiction for any act that would constitute a violation of this part or chapter 455.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice architecture revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country, for any act that would constitute a violation of this part or of chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime that directly relates to the practice of architecture or the ability to practice architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of architecture or the ability to practice architecture.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report or record known to be false, or failing to file required reports, or impeding such filing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record that the licensee knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act of fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of architecture, including failure to ensure responsible supervising control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act of fraud or deceit, or of negligence, incompetency, or misconduct, in the practice of architecture, including, but not limited to, allowing the preparation of any architectural studies, plans, or other instruments of service in an office that does not have a full-time Florida-registered architect assigned to such office or failing to ensure the responsible supervising control of services or projects, as required by board rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice architecture contrary to this part or to a rule of the department or the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a registered architect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a registered architect.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to influence or overrule the professional judgment of an architect by an act that would constitute negligence or threaten public health, safety, or welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to influence or overrule the professional judgment of an architect by an act that, if carried out, would constitute negligence contrary to the exercise of professional judgment in accordance with professionally accepted standards of practice or would threaten the public health, safety, or welfare.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing building code inspection services without satisfying the required insurance requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing building code inspection services under s. 553.791, without satisfying the insurance requirements of that section.

insurance_required.quote: Performing building code inspection services under s. 553.791, without satisfying the insurance requirements of that section.

definition_quote.value: Architecture means the rendering or offering to render services in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. These services include planning, providing preliminary study designs, drawings and specifications, job-site inspection, and administration of construction contracts.
definition_quote.quote: "Architecture" means the rendering or offering to render services in connection with the design and construction of a structure or group of structures which have as their principal purpose human habitation or use, and the utilization of space within and surrounding such structures. These services include planning, providing preliminary study designs, drawings and specifications, job-site inspection, and administration of construction contracts.

methods_authorized.quote: These services include planning, providing preliminary study designs, drawings and specifications, job-site inspection, and administration of construction contracts.

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: A person seeking to obtain a certificate of registration as a registered interior designer and a seal pursuant to s. 481.221 must provide the department with his or her name and address and written proof that he or she has successfully passed the qualification examination prescribed by the Council for Interior Design Qualification

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Interior design" means designs, consultations, studies, drawings, specifications, and administration of design construction contracts relating to nonstructural interior elements of a building or structure.

design_build_authorized.quote: a general contractor who is certified or registered pursuant to the provisions of chapter 489 is not required to be licensed as an architect when negotiating or performing services under a design-build contract as long as the architectural services offered or rendered in connection with the contract are offered and rendered by an architect licensed in accordance with this chapter.

value: individual operating under a fictitious name
permitted_firm_structures.quote: "Business organization" means a partnership, a limited liability company, a corporation, or an individual operating under a fictitious name.

firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.value: one or more of the principal officers of the corporation or limited liability company, or one or more partners of the partnership
firm_licensed_architect_ownership_minimu.quote: one or more of the principal officers of the corporation or limited liability company, or one or more partners of the partnership, and all personnel of the corporation, limited liability company, or partnership who act in its behalf in this state as architects, are registered as provided by this part.

seal_required.quote: Each registered architect shall obtain one seal in a form approved by rule of the board and may, in addition, register her or his seal electronically in accordance with ss. 668.001-668.006. All final construction documents and instruments of service which include drawings, plans, specifications, or reports prepared or issued by the registered architect and being filed for public record shall bear the signature and seal of the registered architect who prepared or approved the document and the date on which they were sealed.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: When the certificate of registration of a registered architect or interior designer has been revoked or suspended by the board, the registered architect or interior designer shall surrender her or his seal to the secretary of the board within a period of 30 days after the revocation or suspension has become effective.

value: 2 hours in specialized or advanced courses on any portion of the Florida Building Code
continuing_education_subject_requirement.quote: the board shall require, by rule adopted pursuant to ss. 120.536(1) and 120.54, 2 hours in specialized or advanced courses on any portion of the Florida Building Code, adopted pursuant to part IV of chapter 553, relating to the licensee's respective area of practice.

continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: The board may make exception from the requirements of continuing education in emergency or hardship cases.

value: Any building upon any farm for the use of any farmer, regardless of cost
Any one-family or two-family residence building, townhouse, or domestic outbuilding appurtenant to any one-family or two-family residence, regardless of cost
Any other type of building costing less than $25,000 (except schools, auditoriums, or buildings intended for public use)
exempt_building_types.quote: No person shall be required to qualify as an architect in order to make plans and specifications for, or supervise the erection, enlargement, or alteration of: (a) Any building upon any farm for the use of any farmer, regardless of the cost of the building; (b) Any one-family or two-family residence building, townhouse, or domestic outbuilding appurtenant to any one-family or two-family residence, regardless of cost; or (c) Any other type of building costing less than $25,000, except a school, auditorium, or other building intended for public use

ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: Has passed the prescribed licensure examination and holds a valid certificate issued by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards, and holds a valid license to practice architecture issued by another state or jurisdiction of the United States.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.value: Misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: Any person who violates any provision of subsection (1) commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: Imposition of an administrative fine not to exceed $1,000 for each count or separate offense and a fine of up to $5,000 for matters pertaining to a material violation of the Florida Building Code as reported by a local jurisdiction.
